sections.title: Racial and Geographic Disparities
details: Disparities in peripheral artery disease (PAD) care among different racial and ethnic groups.
Racial differences exist in the prevalence and treatment of PAD.
Geographic and socioeconomic factors influence disparities in PAD treatment.

sections.title: Epidemiology and Risk Factors
details: Women are disproportionately affected by PAD.
Risk of amputation is higher among patients with diabetes, particularly in racial/ethnic minorities.

sections.title: Socioeconomic and Environmental Factors
details: Access to care varies significantly based on geographic location.
Rural areas show different PAD trends compared to urban areas.
